lessons.lesson: Wi-Fi coverage was only measured after planning, which led to CR-001.
lessons.action_plan: Include an infrastructure survey in the initiation of projects with mobile devices.

lessons.lesson: The vendor's outdated API documentation delayed the integration by two weeks.
lessons.action_plan: Validate the technical documentation with the vendor at the kickoff meeting.

lessons.lesson: Training held at the gate itself sped up the team's adaptation.
lessons.action_plan: Keep on-site training in similar rollouts.

scope.open_items_detail: Queue dashboard on the receiving area monitor, handed over to the Technology team with a 30/06/2027 due date.

remarks: Average service time at the gate was 7 minutes in the 30 days after go-live, below the 8-minute target.
